name: Stopwatch
description: Counts up, with laps — keeps running while the card is closed
author: Lattice

sections.title: Two buttons
items: The right button starts, pauses and resumes — it reads Start, Pause, then Resume, the same way the Focus timer does.
The left button changes with the state: it is Lap while running and Reset while stopped, so there is never a button that would do nothing.

sections.title: Laps
items: Each lap records the moment you pressed it. The newest lap is at the top, with the split for that lap and the total so far.
Laps survive a pause and a resume. Reset clears them along with the time.

sections.title: It keeps counting while the card is closed
items: Only the moment you pressed Start is stored, never the elapsed time. Reopening the card works the number out again, so a stopwatch left running overnight reads the whole night.
That also means sleeping the machine counts as time — it is a wall-clock span, not time spent in front of the screen.
Two Stopwatch widgets do not share one clock: each instance keeps its own time.

changes: First release: start, pause, resume, reset and laps.
Keeps running while the card is closed, because it stores the start moment rather than the time so far.
